aedt_messages: Setup2 : LastAdaptive distributing Direct Solver Memory
Machine Local Machine: Engine terminated unexpectedly

historical_control.profile: Manual HPC, 16 tasks/cores, Direct Solver, 47 GHz

interpretation: Static model equivalence passed. The solver process crashes before producing mesh/solution data, so no S/EEP export can be accepted. Environment/runtime failure is strongly indicated but not proven to be caused by a specific Windows update.
required_recovery: Install the latest available AEDT 2025 R2 service pack or obtain an Ansys-supported HFSSCOMENGINE fix.
Rerun a1x4 solve with manual 16-task configuration.
Require readable S(1,1), a non-empty solution profile, then export S4P and both EEP grids.
Do not start a2x4 or a1x8 solve before a1x4 passes.
